text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...What is this? A surge of power from 
deep within..."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Is it just my imagination, or— did the 
unthinkable truly just happen?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Well, having extra strength never hurt 
nobody.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll make use of whatever I can get my 
hands on.
